response.sql: SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_site_mem_avgs, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_site_ratio_avgs FROM (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zoneregistry, s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: 'Pass a 60.8 GB threshold' means memusagegb strictly greater than 60.8 (not >=).
Rows with proccpu = 0 yield a NULL ratio (division by zero avoided via NULLIF), which is ignored in the average; rows with NULL memusagegb are excluded by the threshold filter.
Sites with a NULL entrystat are kept and form their own group with a NULL status.
